build._doc: No data_wrap step, unlike linktree_mindmap. This portal imports the linktree JSON directly in TypeScript (see modules/data-from-linktree.ts), so esbuild inlines it at build time — there is nothing to fetch at runtime and therefore no data-*.json.js companions to emit or copy.

Portal-local additions, compiled separately and loaded AFTER style.css. It cannot live in src/scss: that path is a symlink to cloud-superapp's stylesheet, so a rule added there would change the Cloud SuperApp mirror too.
Inject navigator.serviceWorker.register(...) before </head>. MUST run BEFORE esbuild_sw so the modified HTML feeds into BUILD_HASH.
Inject single-namespace observability SDK. Mirrors console.* + errors + SW lifecycle to OPFS console.log.

MUST run last — hashes the dist artifacts above to derive BUILD_HASH and inject it into the SW bundle. overrides.css is listed alongside style.css in BOTH lists: left out of hash_of an edit to it would not invalidate the cached SW, and left out of precache it would not be available offline.
